scope: Eighteen original-source excerpt inspections and eight newly authored public/synthetic method notes. This is evidence for bounded admission, not a whole-corpus approval or expert certification.
limitations: Excerpts are short exact text fragments with whitespace normalized, not full-source snapshots.
Original publication date and earliest historical availability are unknown unless explicitly supplied by the source version label.
Current accessibility was observed in the recorded retrieval window; it does not establish historical availability before that window.
Source versions identify the inspected public representation, not an independently archived complete source body.
All original text outside the named reviewed passages is unverified by this receipt.
The 2025 IRS publication is not blanket current-law approval for 2026 or future tax years.
The 17 worked-example tests are synthetic development tests; their interpretation is not independently expert-assessed.
